November 17 30.

Dear Blackburn,

With reference to your letter, dated
November 3, 1930, inquiries show that one Felix
Bauer, who was believed to be of Austrian nationality,
arrived in Shanghai in January 1929 and left here the
following month. On first arriving, Bauer lived at
No. 3A Dent Road, but later removed to No. 7 Kungping
Road. According to a report received by the police
at that time Bauer was living with a Russian woman,
who made a practice of visiting Moscow frequently and
was trading in medicines on behalf of German firms.

I forward herewith for your information
copies of detective reports dated March 24, 1929,
and November 15, 1930 regarding Bauer.

Yours sincerely,

A.D. Blackburn, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

1930年11月17日。

亲爱的布莱克本：

关于您1930年11月3日的来信，经查询显示，一名据信为奥地利国籍的费利克斯·鲍尔 (Felix Bauer) 于1929年1月抵达上海，并于次月离开。初到上海时，鲍尔居住在丹徒路 (Dent Road) 3A号，后迁至公平路 (Kungping Road) 7号。根据当时警方收到的一份报告，鲍尔与一名俄国女子同居，该女子经常前往莫斯科，并代表德国商行从事药品贸易。

现随函附上1929年3月24日和1930年11月15日关于鲍尔的侦探报告副本，供贵方参考。

此致

敬礼

A.D. 布莱克本 (Blackburn) 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

November 15, 30.

Felix Bauer.

Investigation show that a person named Felix Bauer was
in Shanghai at the time indicated in the attached letter of
H.B.M. Consul General. He is known to have suddenly disappeared
in February 1930 since when he has not been seen.
His friend, a Czech named Pavlick, an ex: French Foreign
Legionaire, also left Shanghai in June 1930 on a German steamer
for Europe.
It seems to be very dubious that Bauer's visit to Shanghai
was on behalf of the Soviet Government about the timber trade
prospects in China for this specific branch of the Soviet's
activity is handled exclusively by Comrade Eppert who is attached
to the Soviet Consulate at Tientsin and who makes periodical
visits to Shanghai.
Some two or three years ago a Russian named Felix Bauer
arrived in Shanghai from Samarkand, Russian Turkestan. He
visited Shanghai on two separate occasions and resided at the
Palace Hotel. His description is as follows:- 6ft. tall, light
hair, heavy build, weight about 220 lbs.
pages.zh:
1930年11月15日。

费利克斯·鲍尔。

调查显示，在英国驻沪总领事附函所指出的时间内，一名名为费利克斯·鲍尔的人确在上海。据悉他于1930年2月突然失踪，此后便无人见过他。
他的朋友，一名名叫帕夫利克 (Pavlick) 的捷克人，前法国外籍军团士兵，也于1930年6月乘坐德国轮船离开上海前往欧洲。
鲍尔此次访问上海是代表苏联政府考察对华木材贸易前景的说法似乎非常可疑，因为苏联在这一特定领域的活动 exclusively 由埃珀特同志 (Comrade Eppert) 负责处理，他隶属于苏联驻天津领事馆，并定期访问上海。
大约两三年前，一名名为费利克斯·鲍尔的俄国人从俄属突厥斯坦的撒马尔罕抵达上海。他曾两次访问上海，并住在华懋饭店 (Palace Hotel)。其体貌特征如下：身高6英尺，浅色头发，体格魁梧，体重约220磅。

Copy of Reported dated March 22, 1929.
Felix Bauer

On March 19, 1929, Felix Bauer,an Austrian who
arrived in Shanghai on January 18, 1929 and resided at
No. 3A Dent Road, removed to No. 7 Kungping Road.
Bauer was a war prisoner in Siberia, is about 40
years of age, spent several years in Kamchatka and is
stated to have been engaged in gold digging.
He lives with a Russian woman with whom he has
been cohabiting for the past nine years.
They came to Shanghai from Vladivostock, from
which place his paramour visited Moscow on several
occasions where her relatives are alleged to be residing.
Bauer states he is representing certain German
firms trading in medicines. He also asserts that the
Bolsheviks confiscated $16,000 of his money and that
this was the reason for his having left Vladivostock.
pages.zh:
1929年3月22日报告副本。
费利克斯·鲍尔

1929年3月19日，奥地利人费利克斯·鲍尔于1929年1月18日抵达上海，原居住于丹徒路 (Dent Road) 3A号，后迁至公平路 (Kungping Road) 7号。
鲍尔曾是西伯利亚的战俘，年龄约40岁，在堪察加半岛度过数年，据称从事淘金工作。
他与一名俄国女子同居，两人已共同生活九年。
他们从符拉迪沃斯托克 (Vladivostock) 来到上海，其情妇曾多次从该地前往莫斯科，据称她的亲属居住在那里。
鲍尔声称他代表某些从事药品贸易的德国商行。他还断言布尔什维克没收了他16,000美元，并称这是他离开符拉迪沃斯托克的原因。

S. B. - D. 127.

SECRET

H.B.M. Consulate General,
Shanghai,
November 3rd 1930.

My dear Alers,

India inquires whether we have any record of
the arrival in Shanghai from Calcutta in December 1929
and the departure for Moscow in February 1930 of one
FELIX BAUER. The alleged object of Bauer's visit
to Shanghai was to inquire on behalf of the Soviet
Government about the timber trade prospects in China
and to meet his wife who was awaiting him here.

I should be very grateful for any light you
can throw on this matter.

Yours sincerely,

J.D. Blackham

R.C. Alers, Esq.,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

S2, For attention please.
JAS
7.11.30.

英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海，
1930年11月3日。

亲爱的阿勒斯：

印度方面询问，我们是否有关于费利克斯·鲍尔 (FELIX BAUER) 于1929年12月从加尔各答抵达上海以及于1930年2月前往莫斯科的记录。据称鲍尔访问上海的目的是代表苏联政府考察对华木材贸易前景，并会见在此等候他的妻子。

如蒙赐教，不胜感激。

此致

敬礼

J.D. 布莱克姆 (Blackham)

R.C. 阿勒斯 (Alers) 先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

S2，请留意。
JAS
1930年11月7日。
